function PreloadFiles takes nothing returns nothing

	call PreloadStart()
	call Preload( "smashcraft-match v=1 build=0.0.58 serial=4 local=P1 mode=versus" )
	call Preload( "rules stocks=3 minutes=7" )
	call Preload( "result frames=3000 winner=P1 timed-out=0 interrupted=0" )
	call Preload( "stage id=2 name=Frozen Throne" )
	call Preload( "fighter slot=P1 kind=human player=Tom#1234 character=4 stocks=1 damage=20 kos=3 falls=2 left=0 name=Mountain King" )
	call Preload( "fighter slot=P2 kind=computer character=2 stocks=0 damage=140 kos=2 falls=3 left=0 name=Rifleman" )
	call Preload( "end lines=6" )
	call PreloadEnd( 0.0 )

endfunction
